# TalbotIQ

> AI interview software, recruitment software (ATS), a sales CRM, an ERP for SMEs, document and meeting-notes tools, all running on one private AI engine.

TalbotIQ (Talbotiq Technologies Sdn Bhd, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia) builds AI interview and recruitment software, a sales CRM, an ERP for SMEs, document and meeting-notes tools, and a private AI engine the products run on. Pricing is quote-based; there is no public price list. Facts on these pages are written from the running products and each page states what the product does not do.

## Interview and hiring software
- [All Products: Interview Formats Compared](https://talbotiq.com/products): Nine interview formats in one table (live or async, who asks, how answers are scored, camera needed) plus TalbotIQ's recruitment, CRM, ERP and AI tools.
- [Conversational AI Avatar Interview Software](https://talbotiq.com/products/ai-avatar-interview): An AI avatar conducts the interview and asks the fortieth candidate what it asked the first: no fatigue, no rapport bias, one rubric for every answer.
- [Chat Interview Software: Blind Text Assessments](https://talbotiq.com/products/chat-interview): Behavioural questions answered in text and assessed with no name, face or accent attached, with AI-generated answers detected as they arrive.
- [Conversational Chatbot Interview Software](https://talbotiq.com/products/conversational-chat-interview): An open-ended written interview with no clock and no answer key: a thin answer draws a follow-up, and how a candidate writes under a prompt is assessed.
- [MCQ Interview Software for Screening Rounds](https://talbotiq.com/products/mcq-rounds): Multiple-choice interview rounds with a declared answer set, so scoring is arithmetic rather than judgement, drawn from your own question banks.
- [Mimic: AI Interview Software for Every Candidate](https://talbotiq.com/products/mimic): Mimic interviews every applicant the day they apply, across chat, voice, AI video and a live round, and scores each answer on one rubric with evidence.
- [Recorded Video Interview Software (Asynchronous)](https://talbotiq.com/products/recorded-video-interview): Set the questions once and every applicant answers the same ones, in their own time. No calendars, no time zones, no forty-slot scheduling exercise.
- [Recruitment Software (ATS) for Teams & Agencies](https://talbotiq.com/products/recruitment-software): Recruitment software: seven modules on one licence and one database. Hire Mode for internal talent teams, Agency Mode for staffing firms billing clients.
- [Timed Q&A Interview Software](https://talbotiq.com/products/timed-qa): Timed Q&A interview rounds with a visible per-question limit, so you measure what a candidate knows and how they structure it under pressure.
- [Two-Way Live Interview Software](https://talbotiq.com/products/two-way-interview): Your interviewer, the candidate, and the rubric on screen. Recorded, transcribed and scored against the same criteria as the async rounds.
- [Video Interview Software for Hiring Teams](https://talbotiq.com/products/video-interview): Video interview software: a recorded round every applicant can take the day they apply, scored on one rubric, each score linked to the moment it came from.
- [Voice Interview Software, No Camera Needed](https://talbotiq.com/products/voice-interview): Voice interviews any candidate can take on the phone they already have: no camera, no download, transcribed live and scored on one rubric like every round.

## Business software
- [Business Management System (ERP) for SMEs](https://talbotiq.com/products/business-management-system): An ERP built around how an SME runs: quotation to order, delivery and invoice on one chain of records, with the money questions read off that same chain.
- [Intelligent Document Management & Parsing](https://talbotiq.com/products/document-management): AI extraction reads business cards and receipts in any language, pulls every field, converts currencies and flags tampering, with a person confirming each.
- [AI Meeting Notes & Minute Taker Software](https://talbotiq.com/products/note-taker): Live transcript with real names, a recap the moment you stop, and every open promise carried into the next meeting. Nothing joins your call.
- [Sales CRM: Pipeline, Invoices & Approvals](https://talbotiq.com/products/sales-crm): A sales CRM for the desk and the road: cards, receipts and meetings captured as photos and audio, a configurable pipeline, quote-to-cash and receivables.
- [Task & Productivity Manager with AI Triage](https://talbotiq.com/products/task-manager): Paste the meeting notes and the task manager finds every commitment, creates the task, assigns the owner and sets the date, then reports whether it landed.
- [Vawlt: Private AI Engine with PII Scrubbing](https://talbotiq.com/products/vawlt): The private AI engine behind TalbotIQ products: 27 of 33 AI tasks run on purpose-trained models on our own hardware, each declaring its data handling.

## Services
- [AI Consulting & Development Services](https://talbotiq.com/solutions): TalbotIQ's engagements: AI strategy and consulting, AI agent and bot development, embedded edge AI, and full stack development with AI integration.
- [AI Agent & Bot Development Services](https://talbotiq.com/solutions/ai-agent-bot-development): AI agent and bot development: agents that decompose a request, plan the steps, call the tools and hand back the decisions a person should make.
- [AI Strategy & Consulting Services](https://talbotiq.com/solutions/ai-strategy-consulting): Bridging the gap between speculative AI trends and measurable ROI by replacing manual workflows with autonomous, high-impact agentic systems.
- [Embedded Edge AI Development](https://talbotiq.com/solutions/embedded-edge-ai): Embedded edge AI: vision and sensor fusion deployed on existing hardware for real-time operational intelligence, including agricultural use.
- [Full Stack Development & AI Integration](https://talbotiq.com/solutions/full-stack-ai-integration): Full stack development and AI integration: scalable systems that connect modern applications with existing infrastructure, built for speed and reliability.
